descriptionZh: B27 独立战损木船：108件金属件重新落座、中央船底长缝收合、肋骨细纹和断面端纹修复；保留原船型、主要侧舷破口与49,944三角面。

facingMeasurement.method: Measured original source object vertices after the source-to-runtime transform; BowStem is at the negative-Z end and Transom components at the positive-Z end.

source.defaultExportPlatform: Windows; run the saved packed source through Script_BlenderMcp.mjs start --batch
source.keelNormalStorage: Native Blender 5.2 FLOAT_VECTOR corner custom_normal; no modifier or quantized INT16_2D conversion

original.preservation: Read-only complete restored B18-B27 archive, source/PBR/recipes/intermediate candidates and original evidence retained externally; do not overwrite.

nails.scope: Only translation of existing metal pieces; retain all 201 original metal components and verify actual solid-wood support independently.

keel.policy: Widen existing sole vertices toward the measured inner garboard edges; retain source topology, outer silhouette and main side damage.
keel.actualSeamValidation: PASS: underside normal/fill and magenta-background original/repaired comparison; two central longitudinal openings removed and main side breaches retained

endGrain.selection: Short end polygons selected by object identity and geometric orientation/position; visually check all visible broken ends.

geometryContract.triangulation: Original template triangles and winding retained exactly once; no ordinary vessel glTF re-export or Blender retriangulation.
geometryContract.sourceTopologyAndObjectMatrices: Preserve the 302 asset objects, polygon connectivity and object matrices; original unused vertices remain source-only.
geometryContract.uv: Retain authored runtime/source UV offsets, apply current source-loop deltas, scale rib long-face UVs uniformly by 1.85, and use current planar source UVs on selected end polygons.
geometryContract.normals: Retain authored runtime normals outside KeelSole. Capture source keel corner normals before deformation; transform source and runtime keel normals by the inverse transpose of the exact piecewise-linear width Jacobian. Source keel normals use native FLOAT_VECTOR custom_normal corner storage to avoid measured legacy INT16_2D quantization.
geometryContract.tangents: Retain authored tangents outside selected ends and KeelSole. Keel tangents follow the width Jacobian and retain handedness; end tangents/handedness come from final triangle positions and UVs, with record splits as needed.
geometryContract.normalAuditScope: Cold-source audit checks keel source/runtime inverse-J behavior; authored source/runtime baseline normal differences remain and complete source/runtime normal equality is not claimed.
geometryContract.laterEdits: Topology/face selection or changes beyond the declared normal/tangent policy require updating the recipe, provenance and independent checks.
geometryContract.sourceMaterialSynchronization: Source polygon material slots synchronized to the original runtime triangle provenance before the declared 3-to-2 side and end-to-3 remapping; six original texture bindings unchanged.

pbr.encoding: WebP; replacement Normal/ORM encoded losslessly from native PNG bakes; Base uses the bounded quality policy in Script_SkiffB27Encode.py.

artSource.descriptionZh: 船型与损伤沿用用户提供的 B27；端纹为创作修复，不作船种、年代工艺或史料真实性宣称。
artSource.promptSummary: Weathered boat timber end-grain material reference, varied growth rings and fibre cracks, neutral lighting and no text; used as the mother for short broken timber ends.
artSource.derivation: Native Blender Base/Normal/ORM bake; micro-normal height inferred from mother-image luminance, not scanned or measured wood relief.
artSource.rightsAndHistoryBoundary: Original archive retained as supplied provenance; no new third-party license, public-domain status or historical-evidence claim is asserted. Generated end-grain is an authored material treatment.
artSource.prompt: Flat orthographic macro albedo texture covering the full square with a weathered old boat timber cross section/end grain; muted grey-brown/taupe, fine irregular eccentric growth ring arcs, cut pores and small radial checks; center outside lower left; natural uneven fibres, low contrast neutral diffuse lighting; no bark, objects, text, baked shadows, specular, perfect circles or long parallel side grain.

rebuild.runner: node scripts/Script_BlenderMcp.mjs start --batch Model/SkiffB27/Script_SkiffB27Bake.py --batch-args tmp/SkiffB27/Data_ExportArgs.json --task SkiffB27Export --json
rebuild.externalPythonForInitialize: NumPy/Pillow environment configured through the end-grain baker; default export does not rebake or require that external encoder.
rebuild.deterministicRebuild: PASS: fresh Blender process rebuilt the packed final source to a byte-identical 7,333,052-byte GLB

managedGltfWebgl.nonBlockingTelemetry: Known Three FileLoader stream ERR_ABORTED events retained with complete byte-length/SHA and actual loader/render evidence; no page, console, HTTP or blocking failures

allNailSolidSupport.method: Coordinate-welded connected components (1e-6 m quantization); exact finite edge/triangle intersections in both directions plus coplanar convex overlap; 3-direction parity containment only in closed components, in either containment direction. No distance-based support classification.
allNailSolidSupport.penetrationVolume: Deterministic estimate reported only for closed solids; no watertightness claim

delivery.publicationEvidence: Commit and actual Pages content hash recorded in the external Acceptance/Data_Publish.json after push
